visualCharacteristics: White framed artwork tiles (10px radius, ~350px tall, light border on light sections only), image contained and centred, never cropped; optional title + description below the frame on the section background
contentPattern: logos: framed logo tiles in pairs (lockups) and framed exclusion-zone guide images in threes || ao-reserve: framed logo / device cards with title + description below, plus framed exclusion-zone guide images
usage: One row per item. Cell 1: the artwork image (logo, guide diagram or device; transparent or white PNG/SVG), shown contained and centred in a white rounded frame. Cell 2 (optional): a heading and/or paragraph(s), shown below the frame. 2 items lay out in 2 columns, 3 or more in 3 columns; 1 column on mobile. Add the 'short' option for ~250px frames (e.g. visual devices).
reuseGuidance: Logo lockups, exclusion-zone / minimum-size guides and visual-device showcases on the logos chapter and sub-brand guides (AO Reserve, graphic elements, partner guidelines). Use cards-logo instead for edge-to-edge logo-on-colour tiles.
